organ: the card: a PNG that carries its whole life and shows exactly what it carries
population: every genesis card in drop/log.json (the drop as committed); the forgery suite on every tenth card by serial

rules.claim: Every genesis card, written as a PNG with the real art engine and read back, returns exactly its dossier (canonical bytes equal), with its facts.
Every genesis card written twice is byte-identical: the same life makes the same card.

On every tenth genesis card, each of 12 forgeries — a face pixel flipped, a byte after the dossier, another card’s face, a changed owner, a changed serial, a changed genome byte, a re-wrapped dossier, a cut-short file, a damaged chunk, the wrong size, an event signed by a stranger, the magic removed — is refused, every one.
Reading a card touches no network: every read on the sampled cards runs with the network trapped and never reaches for it.

A level signed into a card by its own owner with made-up numbers still reads (a card proves what it is), and is refused by the registry, which re-runs every level before recording it — on every sampled card.
The median time to read and fully check a card (CRCs, seals, signatures, redrawn face) is at most 250 ms on the measuring machine.
